name: Should I choose a prefabricated base or a custom tiled pan for my low threshold shower?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a prefabricated base or a custom tiled pan for my low threshold shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can choose either, depending on your budget, maintenance goals, and design preferences. Acrylic and fiberglass pans offer quick installation, lower upfront costs, and easy-to-clean surfaces with molded curbs. Custom tile bases provide greater flexibility for irregular bathroom dimensions, high-end aesthetics with materials like marble or porcelain, and custom slopes. However, tile requires thorough waterproofing, regular grout maintenance, and precise finish carpentry to ensure a watertight installation over the subfloor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prefabricated bases are affordable and quick to clean, while custom tiled pans offer tailored sizing, premium finishes, and flexible design at a higher cost.
